name: Subscribe to Restoration Alerts
description: Signs a customer up for restoration text alerts for the address without power. Needs the customer's mobile number and 5-digit ZIP code. Use when the customer wants to be notified when power is restored or when the estimated restoration time changes. Confirm the masked number back to the customer.
samples:
Text me when my power is back
Sign me up for outage alerts
Can you notify me when the power comes back on?
I want restoration updates by text
Send me alerts about my outage

vars.phone: The customer mobile number to receive restoration text alerts. Ask the customer for it.
vars.zip: The 5-digit ZIP code of the address without power.
